Class CompanyRepresentative

Object
User
CompanyRepresentative
public class CompanyRepresentative extends User
Represents a Company Representative user OOP PRINCIPLES APPLIED: 1. INHERITANCE - Extends User class 2. SINGLE RESPONSIBILITY - Only handles company rep-specific data 3. ENCAPSULATION - Status is controlled via enum type
